title: Twin-Court Bulwark Canon
summary: A canon for xiantian bearers on holding a shared front with a partner under one living qi field.

title: Azure-Wing Ward Practice
summary: Teaches a wide ward that unfolds like a wing across the field and shelters allies from heavy attacks.

title: Dual-Track Breaker Treatise
summary: A treatise on breaking an enemy line by two shield tracks that strike and guard in turn.

title: The Hawk-Strike Facing
summary: Teaches the diving bash of the shield in which the bearer drops on an opponent like a hawk.

title: River-Basin Impregnable Guard
summary: Gathers every blow into the basin of the guard and lets the river of the shield carry it away.

title: Paired Bearer's Advanced Canon
summary: Joins two bearers into a single guard whose qi fields overlap and answer each other's strikes.

title: The River-Court Shield Compendium
summary: A rare compendium of the highest mortal-tier shield forms gathered for monarch-level bearers of the river school.

title: Hawk and River Rebuke Treatise
summary: Teaches the rebuke that turns a hawk's dive and a river's flow against an attacker's own force.

title: Wind-Sworn Guard Canon
summary: A canon for sworn bearers on keeping a standing guard against the wind of any assault.

title: Plateau Oath Shield Rites
summary: Rites in which the bearer swears a place on the plateau and holds it with the qi field.

title: The Bearing-Held Board
summary: Teaches the bearer to keep a true bearing through the heaviest blows by the board's steady lean.

title: Gale-Breaker Shield Discipline
summary: A discipline for bearers who break the force of a charging host as a rock breaks a gale.

title: The Unbreaking Oath Shield Rites
summary: Teaches a shield oath that holds when the line and the bearer are near collapse.

title: Plateau Edge Monarch Teachings
summary: A rare set of teachings for monarch-level bearers who hold the open edge of the plateau.

title: Standing Wind Treatise
summary: A treatise on standing unmoved as the wind rises and then answering it with a single shove.

title: The Sworn Bearer's Last Guard
summary: Teaches the last guard a sworn bearer keeps when allies have fallen and only the oath remains.
